title: AntiRKN cloud snapshot v5
description: Plain JSON inside the encrypted Google Drive appDataFolder snapshot used by automatic sync only. It carries intent: what the user decided and what cannot be read back from a server or Drive. Observations, compiled profiles, runner answers and publication results stay in the local cache of each device. The file backup (.antirkn) keeps format 4 and is not described here. Record sources are JSON documents encoded as strings, except template-draft (YAML text).

author.description: The device that captured the snapshot, for choosing between versions.

serverProfile.description: SSH access: address, port, login, key or password, pinned host key, sudo mode, name. The last observed server facts are cache.

vpnWorkspace.description: Document vpn-workspace-v1: workspace id, clients, deleted clients until fully revoked, resource specifications set by the user, per-target server bindings and unfinished operations.

vpnServerRecord.description: Intent and operation state of one target: identity, resourceWorkspaceId, operation, pending, flags. authorizedPayload is kept only while it differs from the last applied payload; job only while it is not terminal. An empty record is omitted.

vpnProfile.description: Only the publication namespace of a client survives; compiled YAML and its hash are rebuilt locally.

runnerJournal.description: Document runner/<server>: present only while an operation is unfinished (pending request, operation metadata or a job that is not terminal). Panel access, discovery, egress and finished jobs are read back from the runner.

localDocuments.description: Document ids that never enter the cloud snapshot: verified publication results are confirmed against Drive.
